- Target bonus: 10% (performance)

Thanks for the writeup. A few items from comp band side:

- Base $150k is within CB-SDE2-2026 (mid-to-high). Good.
- Recommend equity at 0.18% rather than 0.20% to keep alignment with the band midpoint and preserve budget for a potential near-term L5 hire. If candidate pushes we can escalate.
- Sign-on: $15k is above our typical $10k threshold for offers without exec approval. If this is critical to secure him and you have strong business justification, we can approve but will require Finance sign-off (workflow: finance-ops ticket).

Please confirm whether you want to proceed with 0.18% equity and if you can justify the $15k sign-on. If yes, I’ll mark comp approval in Workday and route to Finance for sign-on authority.
